solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Miss rising and almost get up after retiring

indicators.note: after places the shortened word for 'get up' behind the reversed one
in a down entry, rising means the word for 'miss' is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: to miss something is to omit it

indicators.note: almost means the last letter of the synonym for 'get up' is dropped

parts.note: to get up or stir is to rouse

explanation.surface: Someone who misses a rising alarm and barely manages to get out of bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Miss rising' gives TIMO (OMIT upwards), and 'almost get up' gives ROUS (ROUSE shortened). 'Retiring' looks like part of the getting-up story but is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A retiring person is shy and nervous, which is what timorous describes.

clue.text: Cricket possibly dropped in school

indicators.note: dropped means the word 'in' is taken out of the insect

parts.note: a cricket is an example of an insect, hence 'possibly'
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cricket match being abandoned at a school.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cricket' suggests the game; here it is the insect. Drop IN from INSECT to leave the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A school of thought or belief is a faction or religious group with shared doctrine.

clue.text: Very light head inhaling carbon monoxide

indicators.note: inhaling means the head takes the gas inside it

parts.note: bean is slang for the head
CO is the chemical formula for carbon monoxide

explanation.surface: A light-headed feeling after breathing in carbon monoxide.
explanation.walkthrough: A Very light is a coloured signal flare fired from a pistol, not something of little weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a Very light and a beacon are signal lights used to give warning or guidance.

clue.text: Armstrong shortly ascending, knocked back and cut off

indicators.note: in a down entry, ascending means those letters are read upwards

parts.note: Neil A., the moonwalker's first name with his surname cut to its initial
to knock back food or drink is to consume it, so ate

explanation.surface: The astronaut Armstrong, briefly lifting off, then being repelled and cut off from Earth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Armstrong shortly' is the astronaut Neil A. (Armstrong), which upwards gives ALIEN.
explanation.definitionFit: To alienate someone is to estrange them, cutting them off from friends or society.

clue.text: Contrived and formulaic if I translate parts backwards

indicators.note: backwards means the letters found are read in reverse
the letters sought are parts of the words 'formulaic if I translate'

explanation.surface: A translator complaining that rendering text in reverse produces something stilted and formulaic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Translate' looks like an anagram signal, but the letters LAICIFITRA lie in a run across 'formulaic if I translate'; 'backwards' turns them round.
explanation.definitionFit: Something contrived is forced and unnatural, the sense of artificial.

clue.text: Chronicles of Aslan, Narnia turned up

indicators.note: turned up says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The Chronicles of Narnia, C.S. Lewis's books in which the lion Aslan appears.
explanation.definitionFit: Annals are historical records kept year by year, just as chronicles are.

clue.text: Indefatigable team leader lacking passion

indicators.note: the leader of 'team' is its first letter

parts.note: ire is anger, a fierce passion
lacking means without, which is less as a suffix

explanation.surface: A tireless captain who nonetheless seems to lack fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lacking passion' reads as one idea, but the word for 'lacking' follows the passion, as in a suffix like 'passionless'; 'leader' picks T.
explanation.definitionFit: Indefatigable means never tiring, which is the sense of the answer exactly.

clue.text: Reportedly collapses and agrees in time

indicators.note: reportedly signals that a word heard spoken is wanted

parts.note: a thing that collapses sinks down

explanation.surface: News of something collapsing, and someone agreeing on the timing.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that synchronise match each other in timing, which this abbreviated verb means.

clue.text: Enticing number, wearing oddly loud outfit

indicators.note: oddly takes the first and third letters of 'loud'
wearing means the number has the loud outfit around it, like a garment

parts.note: a rig is a set of clothes, an outfit

explanation.surface: A tempting number, perhaps a performer, dressed in something rather loud.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oddly' gives LU from 'loud'; N goes inside LURIG.
explanation.definitionFit: Luring someone is tempting them in, which is what enticing does.

clue.text: Attack animal

definitions.meaning: to attack them, written as one word

explanation.surface: An animal that attacks, or a command to attack it.
explanation.definitionFit: Split as two words the answer means to attack; whole, it is a horned farm creature.

clue.text: Seasoned with time in agreeable surroundings

indicators.note: in places the time inside the agreeable word

parts.note: congenial means agreeable; 'surroundings' says this word goes round the other piece

explanation.surface: Mellowing over time in pleasant surroundings, like a well-aged wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seasoned' suggests matured or flavoured; here it means habitual, as in 'a seasoned liar' and 'a congenital liar'.
explanation.definitionFit: Both describe something inveterate or ingrained, as in a habitual liar.

clue.text: City street learner reversed around

indicators.note: around says the reversed learner goes round the street
reversed means that word is read backwards

parts.note: a noob is a slang word for a newcomer or learner

explanation.surface: A learner driver in a city reversing round a street.
explanation.definitionFit: Boston is a large city in Massachusetts, and also a town in Lincolnshire.

clue.text: Grind up then pound with fork getting thinner

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: the daily grind is a routine, a rut
a pound is an enclosure for animals, a pen
a tine is a prong of a fork

explanation.surface: Kitchen instructions: grind something, pound it, then work it with a fork until it thins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pound' and 'Grind' look like cooking verbs but both are nouns here.
explanation.definitionFit: Turpentine is a solvent used to thin oil paints, so it is a paint thinner.

clue.text: Most grizzled ram in herd sharing central grassland

indicators.note: in places the ram inside the herd
sharing means the herd and ram use one copy of the central letter between them, so the herd's is lost

parts.note: a host is a large crowd or herd

indicators.note: central takes the middle letter of the nine-letter 'grassland'

parts.note: Aries is the zodiac sign of the ram

explanation.surface: A grizzled old ram in a flock on the central grazing land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sharing' means herd and ram share one S, the centre letter of 'grassland', so it appears only once; 'in' puts the ram inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoary means grey or white with age, so the most hoary is the most grizzled.

clue.text: Painful turn given by Queen in European country

indicators.note: in places the queen inside the country

parts.note: Spain is a country in Europe
R is short for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A queen twisting her ankle while abroad on the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Given by' is a link joining definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprain is a twisting injury to a joint, a painful turn of the ankle or wrist.

clue.text: Improper naughty observation initially about half-naked butt

definitions.text: Improper naughty observation initially about half-naked butt

indicators.note: about means those three initials go round the rest
initially takes the first letter of each of 'Improper', 'naughty' and 'observation'
half means only the first two letters of the synonym for 'naked' are kept

parts.note: naked means nude
a butt is the end of something, as in a cigarette butt

explanation.surface: A cheeky remark about a half-bare backside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Initially' gives INO, which goes 'about' the rest. The whole clue also defines: a rude suggestive remark about a bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: An insinuating, suggestive remark with a smutty double meaning is exactly an improper hint of this kind.

clue.text: Wicked Left to start heartless Tory silliness

indicators.note: to start means the L is moved to the front of the word

parts.note: wicked means evil

indicators.note: heartless removes the middle letters of 'Tory', leaving the outer two

explanation.surface: A political sketch: wicked Left-wingers starting on a heartless Tory, all rather silly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to start' moves L from the end of EVIL to make LEVI; 'heartless' leaves TY from 'Tory'.
explanation.definitionFit: Levity is a lack of seriousness, frivolity or light-hearted silliness.

clue.text: Having yen before realising this?

indicators.note: before puts the Y in front of the other piece

parts.note: Y is the symbol for the yen, Japan's currency
realising money means making it, earning it

explanation.surface: Having a strong desire for money before actually making some.
explanation.walkthrough: Yen means a longing as well as the Japanese currency; the whole clue defines a craving that comes before getting.
explanation.definitionFit: A yen is a craving, so having one is longing or wishing for something.

clue.text: Standing up, quietly released noxious gas? Run away!

indicators.note: in a down entry, standing up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
to Mace someone is to spray them with a noxious tear gas

explanation.surface: Someone who quietly broke wind while standing up, then fled the scene.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests flatulence, but the gas is Mace, a tear-gas spray; PMACED read upwards gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to leave suddenly or secretly, that is to flee.

clue.text: From abstinence in teens getting in trouble?

definitions.text: From abstinence in teens getting in trouble?

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A question about teenage abstinence campaigns ending in unwanted pregnancy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Getting in trouble' is the old euphemism for an unwanted pregnancy, and the whole clue describes the outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: Enceinte is a French-derived word for expecting a baby, the state a girl 'in trouble' was in.

clue.text: Sailor found in hold?

definitions.meaning: Horatio, Lord ... was Britain's most famous admiral
a wrestling hold with the arm under the opponent's and the hand on the neck

explanation.surface: A sailor turning up in a ship's hold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hold' suggests the cargo space of a ship, but it is a wrestling grip.
explanation.definitionFit: The admiral of Trafalgar is the sailor; the full or half nelson is the wrestling grip.

clue.text: Rock music, sort of backing, including 'Bad'

indicators.note: including means the reversed music goes round the word for bad
backing means the music is read backwards

parts.note: rap is a sort of music
ill means bad, as in ill effects

explanation.surface: A rock band whose backing music includes the song 'Bad'.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock' looks like the music genre but is the definition: a dependable person, a pillar of strength.
explanation.definitionFit: A dependable person is a rock or a pillar of the community, a mainstay.

clue.text: Steep paddy ends containing its crop

indicators.note: containing means the paddy's ends go round the crop
the ends of 'paddy' are its first and last letters

parts.note: rice is the crop grown in a paddy field

explanation.surface: A steep, terraced paddy field holding its rice crop.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Steep' suggests terraced hillsides, but it means expensive.
explanation.definitionFit: Steep prices are high ones, so steep means expensive.

clue.text: One description overturned about young and famous

indicators.note: about means the reversed letters go round the young
overturned means one and the description are read backwards

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral
a tag is a label or descriptive name
a litter is a group of young animals born together

explanation.surface: A description of someone young and famous turned on its head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Overturned' turns ITAG into GATI, which then goes about LITTER. 'The famous' as a group are the celebrities.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebrities collectively are the glamorous set: the famous people.

clue.text: Hue of rose flower

definitions.meaning: a pale red shade, the colour of many roses
a garden plant, a type of dianthus

explanation.surface: The colour of a rose bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Pale red is a hue, and the dianthus garden plant shares the colour's name.

clue.text: Bowls and game's over

indicators.note: over means the word is turned upside down, reading upwards in a down entry

parts.note: snap is a card game

explanation.surface: A game of bowls finishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bowls' looks like the lawn game but means basins; 's is 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Basins or vessels for cooking or washing are pans, as bowls are.

clue.text: Dead possessed, then shot

parts.note: possessed means owned

explanation.surface: A grim sequence: someone dead, possessed, then shot.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird or plane that is brought down by gunfire is shot down.

clue.text: Power exercising authority with child

parts.note: regnant means reigning, exercising royal authority

explanation.surface: A powerful ruler who is expecting a baby.
explanation.definitionFit: Being with child is the old-fashioned way of saying expecting a baby.
